clue.text: Sheet of film with attention turned around one vegetable

parts.note: a cel is a transparent sheet used in hand-drawn animation film

indicators.note: around says the reversed word wraps round the single letter for one
turned says the word for attention is read backwards

parts.note: care means attention, as in handle with care
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A film technician fiddling with acetate while keeping an eye on a single root vegetable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sheet of film' is an animation cel, not a roll of camera film; 'turned' acts on the attention word before 'around' encloses the one.
explanation.definitionFit: Celeriac is a knobbly root vegetable, a variety of celery grown for its swollen base.

clue.text: Race venue — base for excellent course

indicators.note: for says one piece stands in place of another

parts.note: Aintree is the Liverpool racecourse that hosts the Grand National steeplechase
A1, often written AI in crosswords, means first-rate
e is the base of natural logarithms

explanation.surface: A racecourse is the ideal setting for a fine meal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'base for excellent' means E replaces AI in AINTREE, the British racecourse.
explanation.definitionFit: An entrée is a dish served as one course of a meal.

clue.text: Arms almost drained after climbing

indicators.note: climbing in a down clue says the letters are read upwards, backwards
almost says the last letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: seeped means leaked away, drained out

explanation.surface: Arms nearly exhausted after a long climb.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' trims SEEPED to SEEPE, and 'climbing' turns it upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Épées are fencing swords, so they are weapons, arms.

clue.text: Giant set free bears I provoke

indicators.note: bears says the rearranged letters carry the I inside them
free says the letters are released from their order and rearranged

explanation.surface: A giant who has been released is something I goad.
explanation.definitionFit: To instigate is to stir up or bring about trouble, to incite.

clue.text: Three-quarters of counter not for alcohol

parts.note: a chip is a gambling counter
anti means against, not for

explanation.surface: A barman refusing to serve drink across part of the counter.
explanation.definitionFit: Chianti is a red wine from Tuscany, an alcoholic drink.

clue.text: Made brilliant new addition in cast

indicators.note: addition in says the letter for new is added inside the word for cast

parts.note: shied means threw or cast, as at a coconut shy

explanation.surface: A newcomer joining the cast of a play made the show sparkle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cast' looks like a theatre company but is a past-tense verb: SHIED, thrown.
explanation.definitionFit: Shined is the past tense of shine in the sense of polish, making something gleam.

clue.text: Note fliers must be brought up to date

parts.note: so, or soh, is the fifth note of the sol-fa scale

indicators.note: brought up in a down clue says the letters are read upwards, backwards

explanation.definitionFit: So far means up to the present, until now.

clue.text: Mesh cover in earth above enclosure for vessels

a lock is a gated section of canal where boats are raised and lowered

explanation.surface: A mesh cover laid on soil above a boat basin.
explanation.definitionFit: Gears that mesh fit together and engage, linking tightly.

clue.text: Calls resolved insurance matters, presumably

definitions.meaning: split as ... it means former claims, settled ones on a policy

explanation.surface: Phone calls dealing with settled insurance business.
explanation.definitionFit: To exclaim is to cry out suddenly, to call out.

clue.text: Maybe 3 fingers articulated

indicators.note: articulated says the word is spoken, giving a word that sounds the same

parts.note: to finger something can mean to pilfer it, so fingers means steals

explanation.surface: Three fingers flexing at their joints, like a jointed limb.
explanation.walkthrough: '3' points to the answer at 3-down, EPEES, of which this answer is a broader class. 'fingers' looks anatomical but means pilfers.
explanation.definitionFit: Steels is a poetic term for swords, and épées are one kind of sword, hence 'maybe'.

clue.text: Computing chief not at fault

indicators.note: at fault says these letters are wrong as they stand and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: The head of IT insists they are blameless.
explanation.definitionFit: Infotech is a short form of information technology, a field of computing.

clue.text: Transfer rule broken by idiot

parts.note: to reign is to rule as a monarch
an ass is a fool or idiot

explanation.surface: A transfer policy has been wrecked by some fool.
explanation.definitionFit: To reassign someone is to move them to a different post, a transfer.

clue.text: Go over area used by rose to place further on

indicators.note: to place further on says the letter for area is moved later in the word for rose

parts.note: reared means rose up, as a horse does

explanation.surface: A gardener reviewing which patch a rose bush should be moved to.

explanation.definitionFit: To go over a text is to read it once more, a synonym.

clue.text: Photoshop wedding pictures where guests congregate

explanation.definitionFit: Formal reception rooms in a house are where visitors are received and entertained.

clue.text: Daughter mocking boxing learner showing sports technique

parts.note: ribbing means teasing, mocking
L is the learner driver's plate letter

explanation.surface: A daughter teasing a novice boxer about their footwork.
explanation.walkthrough: 'boxing' looks like the sport but means enclosing.
explanation.definitionFit: In football and basketball, keeping the ball close while moving is a core skill.

clue.text: Good not to run so much when clumsy

parts.note: split 4,4 race less, to run less

explanation.surface: A good athlete told not to train so hard while they are clumsy.
explanation.definitionFit: Lacking grace and poise means awkward in movement.

clue.text: Provide translation for Italian in toned-down clothing

parts.note: subtle means muted or toned-down

clue.text: Book posh functions with flash commercial location

clue.text: Disgrace, being roughly grabbed in wood

indicators.note: grabbed in says the letter is held inside the word for wood

parts.note: sandal, short for sandalwood, is a fragrant wood

clue.text: On net, give up gossip

up in a down clue says the letters are read upwards, backwards

parts.note: to sag is to give or yield under weight

clue.text: Inwardly tense, advance through squat

by can mean through or by means of

clue.text: We might get grave introducing such measures for church property

definitions.text: We might get grave introducing such measures for church property

parts.words: We might get grave introducing such measures for church property

clue.text: Sugar, perhaps, is cut by day recalled one of islanders

clue.text: Fragment of altar's inside sections of framework

clue.text: Restraint in flight 22 performed by staff

clue.text: European conveyed to the port deck

clue.text: Bridge player to gradually shift spades and clubs

clue.text: They secure a great deal

definitions.meaning: ropes or cords that tie things down
plenty, as in custard in great quantity
